messages.subject: Helpdesk renewal — new pricing for 2026/27
messages.body:
Dear Ms Bello,

Your Helpdesk subscription is due for renewal on 1 July 2026. I am writing to share our new pricing ahead of the renewal: your annual fee will increase from €4,800 to €6,720, reflecting our updated per-agent rates and the platform improvements shipped this year (new reporting suite, SSO, expanded knowledge base).

If you renew before 15 June we can apply an early-bird discount of 5%. I would be happy to schedule a call to walk you through the changes.

Kind regards,
Marc Zuidema
Account Management, Helpdesk Co.

messages.subject: RE: Beacon Desk — formal quote request for 12 agents
messages.body:
Hi Aisha,

Quote attached and all three points confirmed in writing: €5,400/year for 12 agents, year-two price locked at the same rate, KB migration and implementation support included with go-live July 1 and migration verified by June 27.

One practical note: we'll need a read-only export from your current tool about a week before go-live — I'll coordinate the exact date with you.

Kind regards,
Femke Dekker
Customer Solutions, Beacon Desk

messages.subject: RE: Helpdesk renewal +40% — time to look at Beacon Desk
messages.body:
ok, beacon from july 1. aisha handle it. don't renew helpdesk.

M
Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: RE: Helpdesk renewal +40% — time to look at Beacon Desk
messages.body:
Done 😊 Signing with Beacon today, and I'll decline the Helpdesk renewal before their June 15 early-bird deadline so there's no ambiguity. Femke — please count on the export around June 22.

Also, I promised the team we'd keep the old tickets archived read-only for a year — I'll confirm the export format with Beacon covers that.

Aisha
